subject: Room Change Notification - $module_code
body:
Dear $first_name $last_name,

Please be advised that there has been a room change for one of your classes.

Class Details:
- Module: $module_code
- Day: $day
- Time: $start_time - $end_time
- Old Room: $old_room
- New Room: $new_room

Please make note of this change.

$signature
